definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. regin-djúpr very deep; regin-djúp the mighty deep : O. H. Ger. Regin-hart.

source_text: regn-heard; adj. Exceedingly hard, wondrous hard :-- Rondas regn-hearde, Beo. Th. 657; B. 326. [Cf. Icel. regin-djúpr very deep; regin-djúp the mighty deep : O. H. Ger. Regin-hart.] v. regn-.
